verdict.rationale: A public first-party GitHub repository (letta-ai/letta) exists and describes the Letta Agent SDK, which suggests some of the source is readable. The pack never states which license applies or how much of the product the repository covers. Self-hosting docs show the product can run locally but say nothing about licensing. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence (e.g. Apache/MIT), confirmation of which components (server, CLI, SDK) are published, independent corroboration.
